definitions.current_demand: During each admission-to-completion span, sum its own per-SSU V / own original C; includes stalled spans.
definitions.prefetch_reference: During each actual compute span only, sum next layer per-SSU V / current C; includes next-request L0.
definitions.strict_upper: Per SSU sum over NPU: maximum any next V divided by minimum any current C in its frozen deck.
definitions.unavoidable_lower_bound: max(max_s V_s/40, total V/50) minus available C; storage/link overlap allowed; ignores small packet latency.
definitions.limits: A demand reference above 40 is not actual service above 40 and alone does not prove deadline infeasibility; internal stall alone does not prove FIFO causation.
definitions.workload: All t=0, fixed NPU, serial batch=1; independent random per-NPU permutation; seed and selected-candidate scope matter.
